versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 of weibo-hot-cn

- No file changes in this release.
- No updates to functionality or documentation.

Initial release of weibo-hot-cn: Monitor and analyze Weibo trending topics.

- Real-time retrieval of Weibo Hot Search Top 50 with heat indices and topic labels.
- Trend analysis features: fastest rising, persistent topics, and (if available) regional distribution.
- Sentiment monitoring: keyword alerts, hot search change notifications, and hot search history snapshots.
- Clear examples for retrieving, monitoring, and analyzing Weibo trends.
- Integration suggestions for comparing with other Chinese social media hotlists.
